findings.title: AI-authored figures are required by the requirements (AC 4.4.2 'both required', AC 4.6.2) but never mandated in the seed set
findings.problem: The seed-validation test asserts the union of INTERACTIVE explainer kinds covers all seven FR-EXP kinds, but never asserts any 'figure'-kind explainer / embedded PNG exists. The '2..=4 explainers per lesson' cap counts figure and interactive kinds together, so a figure-free seed set passes validation. §12.1 allows a full fallback to deterministic SVG and §18.4 marks the genmedia figure set as 'stretch', creating a live path where the shipped seed set contains zero embedded figure PNGs, contradicting AC 4.4.2 ('both required') and AC 4.6.2.
findings.fix: Either (a) make figures genuinely required and add a seed assertion (e.g. >=1 figure-kind explainer with a decoding embedded PNG per lesson, or >=N across the set) and reconcile §18.4 so figures are not 'stretch'; or (b) cite an owner decision that an all-deterministic-diagram seed set satisfies AC 4.4.2(ii), and drop the 'both required' language from the implementer-facing contract so §14/§15 and the requirement agree. Remove the ambiguity about whether a figure-free seed set is shippable.

findings.title: The 'zero runtime network' offline guarantee is asserted but the listed tests cannot prove it for the frontend render path
findings.where: docs/LESSONS.md §11.2, §15 (OQ-11 offline enforcement), AC 4.2.2, FR-OFF-1, NFR-2; COORDINATION.md §5
findings.problem: AC 4.2.2 requires zero network when taking a present bundle, enforced and tested so a network-disabled take 'behaves identically'. The design's test stubs the Rust network client to fail and asserts the take succeeds, which proves AI is not required but does not prove the React/CSS render path makes no outbound request (CDN @font-face, remote /, analytics beacon, remote SVG xlink:href). check-ai-provider-policy.py checks AI hosts / default URLs / startup-save network, not arbitrary outbound URLs in the Lessons bundle. The stated enforcement does not cover the stated guarantee.
findings.fix: Specify a frontend-covering enforcement: (a) a build/test guard that greps the compiled Lessons bundle + Lessons.css for any non-local http(s):// or url( reference and fails on a match; and/or (b) a Tauri CSP note restricting connect-src/img-src/font-src for the Lessons surface; and/or (c) an explicit assertion that Lessons.css uses only bundled Inter and imports no remote asset. Name which is authoritative.

findings.title: Stale 'three views' header comment in Shell.tsx not included in the edit list
findings.problem: Shell.tsx's top comment says 'one of three views (Record / Recordings / Chat)' and AppMode is the three-value union (verified at line 23). The design lists the AppMode enum edit and the DESIGN.md nav-table edit but not the stale in-file comment, which will then contradict the four-view reality.
findings.fix: Add the Shell.tsx top-of-file comment to the §17 edit list (update to 'one of four views (Record / Recordings / Lessons / Chat)') alongside the AppMode change.

findings.title: No floor guarantees a 'balance'-kind quiz item exists in the balancing lesson's checkpoint
findings.problem: The 'balance' kind exists specifically to make balancing gradeable, and §14 makes Lesson 2 the balancing lesson, but the §10.1b floors only constrain total count and per-concept coverage, not that any balance-kind item appears. A balancing checkpoint that tests balancing only via MC would pass validation, undercutting the kind.
findings.fix: Add a seed assertion that Lesson 2's checkpoint contains >=1 balance item (or: every concept whose explainer kind is equation_balancer is covered by >=1 balance-kind quiz item), and add it to the §15 item-bank-floor tests.
